subject: Writing
description: The Writing LDG maps the progression from letter formation to coherent composition. Writing difficulties often reveal underlying reading or language gaps.

competencies.label: Letter Formation
competencies.description: Forming letters correctly and consistently; handwriting fluency.

misconceptions.rootGap: Has not internalized letter orientation patterns.
misconceptions.evidence: Consistently writes mirror images even after correction; cannot self-correct.
misconceptions.strategy: Multi-sensory letter practice: sand tracing, sky writing, verbal path cues ('around, up, down').

competencies.label: Spelling
competencies.description: Encoding sounds into written letters; applying spelling patterns and rules.

misconceptions.observed: Spells phonetically but incorrectly ('sed' for 'said', 'wuz' for 'was').
misconceptions.rootGap: Relies only on phonics; has not learned common irregular words or spelling patterns.
misconceptions.evidence: All spellings are plausible phonetically but orthographically wrong.
misconceptions.strategy: Word sorts by pattern; high-frequency word walls; 'look, cover, write, check' for irregular words.

competencies.label: Sentence Construction
competencies.description: Writing complete, grammatically correct sentences with subject-verb agreement.

misconceptions.observed: Writes run-on sentences or fragments. No sense of where a sentence ends.
misconceptions.rootGap: Does not understand that a sentence expresses one complete thought.
misconceptions.evidence: Writing is a stream of 'and then… and then…' with no punctuation.
misconceptions.strategy: Oral rehearsal before writing; sentence combining exercises; colour-code subject and predicate.

competencies.label: Paragraph Structure
competencies.description: Organizing sentences around a main idea into a coherent paragraph.

misconceptions.observed: Writes unrelated sentences in a paragraph; no topic sentence.
misconceptions.rootGap: Does not plan before writing; writes as thoughts come.
misconceptions.evidence: Each sentence introduces a new, unrelated idea.
misconceptions.strategy: Hamburger model (topic sentence, details, closing); graphic organizers; write from outlines.

competencies.label: Extended Composition
competencies.description: Planning, drafting, revising, and editing longer pieces with clear purpose and audience.

misconceptions.observed: Cannot sustain a narrative or argument beyond a few sentences.
misconceptions.rootGap: Has not internalized a planning process; writes without structure.
misconceptions.evidence: Starts strong but trails off; ideas are jumbled; no clear beginning, middle, end.
misconceptions.strategy: Plan → Draft → Revise → Edit cycle. Story maps. Peer feedback on structure before mechanics.
